# Commit ids in the public copy

The public copy rewrites some commit messages and author or committer addresses,
and replaces personal absolute environment-file paths in two historical file
versions with the explicit MAIN_ENV input. Commit dates are preserved. The path
redaction changes 19 historical commit trees; other file contents are unchanged
by that redaction. The file contents at the submission tag remain unchanged.
A changed commit and each descendant receive new ids. This table maps ids cited
in Markdown to the equivalent commits in the redacted copy. Mapping checks allow
only the two disclosed path substitutions when comparing the old and public
trees.

## Historical tree ids

Evidence notes retain the tree ids recorded when their measurements ran. The
path redaction changes the tree ids below; these mappings do not mean that the
measurements were rerun. In particular, e2e-main-1030-1852-NOTE.md recorded the
old tree of 92ecf12.
